lines.text: In order to grow, you have to work hard.
Hi there. I hope today's another good day.
I'm glad to have Rem and Ram by my side, 'cause I know I can rely on them.
May the blessings of the spirits be with you.

People always treat me differently because I'm a half elf, but not you.
I'm grateful that you treat me as I am.
What a fascinating place this is! I'll have to tell everyone about it when I return to my world!
Shall we go for a walk with Puck?
Do you have something important to take care of? Take care and come back safely.
The weapons Nikkes have are absolutely fascinating!
There are so many shiny buildings! It's a sight I've never seen in Lugunica.
What's that delicious smell? It's making me hungry.
My name is Emilia. Nice to meet you.
We still have a long way to go, but I'll work even harder!
It seems that I've grown somewhat.
I've gained a bit more confidence, thanks to you.
Are you giving this to me? Thank you.
This is fantastic! Looks like Puck's a fan as well.
Thanks! I'll definitely find a way to repay you, I promise!
Thank you for taking care of even the small things.
I'm not used to receiving kindness from others... Still, it brings me joy.
I've made so many wonderful memories, all thanks to you.
You can count on me!
What is it?
Are you sure that's where you want me to go?
I'm gonna crush them into dust!
Let's do this!
I will overcome this!
Puck, let's go!
I need more time!
Argh, hold on!
I'm almost done!
I'm all set!
You asked for this, and I thank you for it.
Let's work together!
Yeah!
Go away!
It's done!
Gah!
Agh!
Kyaa!
Sorry... I know I wasn't much help...
I'm glad you're safe. Everyone has worked incredibly hard!
May you be blessed by the spirits.
Rem and I baked a batch of cookies. Would you like some?

It's a good thing Rem and Ram are here with me.
I'd probably lose my head if I were here alone.
Rem made some tea. You're free to join us if you like.

This outfit is quite different from what we have at the mansion. 
Am I wearing it correctly?

What should I say to the customers?
"May I help you?"
Puck usually helps me with my hair. How does it look?
Is it okay if I wait here? Safe travels!
A train? I didn't realize Nikkes rode such dragon carriages.

I'll be volunteering at the Maid Cafe for a little while.
Do come along!

I made omurice with Cocoa today.
What was that magic spell that makes it taste better again?
My name is Emilia. I'll do my best to help from now on.
If I want to become a tried-and-true maid, I need to work even harder.
I think I'm starting to get the hang of being a maid!

It's because of you that I've been able to work this hard.
I'll repay you somehow, promise!

Is this really for me?
Hehe, thanks a bunch!
Thanks for the gift!
Thank you. I feel I should give you something in return... Are you hungry? I can make some curry for you. It's my specialty!
Thanks for always treating me equally!
I'll repay you with the best service, just like Ade said... right? Oh, wait, no?

Coming to a place I didn't know made me anxious, 
but you really helped put my mind at ease.
Leave it to me!
You called?
What's that over there?
Come on, everyone!
Time to buckle down!
Your time is up, dastardly villain!
Puck, a little help here!
I've gotta calm down...
Sorry, I've been pushing myself too hard.
I'll be back in a second!
That concludes our preparation.
I'll give you my best shot!
Here goes nothing!
Victory is mine!
I've got this covered!
Stay down!
Eeep!
Ouch!
Aargh!
I'm sorry for being inadequate...
Well done! We couldn't have done this without everyone's help!
